title: OpenWrt DHCP Lease Churn
app: OpenWrt, UniFi, Pi-hole, AdGuard Home, Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnel, DNS over HTTPS resolvers, and scheduled probes via syslog, APIs, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=openwrt:syslog event=dhcp_lease
| bin _time span=1d
| stats dc(client_mac) as unique_clients, count as lease_events by router _time
| where lease_events>unique_clients*3
| sort - lease_events
description: Uses OpenWrt DHCP lease logs telemetry to monitor days with unusually noisy lease churn in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for clients or firmware that keep bouncing on the network, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest OpenWrt DHCP lease logs data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Daily router table of lease events versus unique clients.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates days with unusually noisy lease churn so you can spot clients or firmware that keep bouncing on the network before it becomes annoying.
